subtitle: A moist, dark sponge with rich toffee sauce, suited to diners who enjoy a sweet, traditional British dessert.
quickAnswer: Wetherspoons sticky toffee pudding typically costs {price}, contains {calories} kcal, and is described with vanilla ice cream or hot custard. The pudding combines a moist, dark sponge with rich, buttery toffee sauce. Prices vary by pub, so check the local menu for the current price and which accompaniment is offered.

components.name: Dark sponge pudding
components.note: The moist, dark sponge gives the dessert a light texture while retaining the richness of a traditional pudding.

components.name: Toffee sauce
components.note: A generous covering of sweet, buttery toffee sauce brings a deep, caramelised flavour to the sponge.

components.name: Vanilla ice cream

taste:
This is a sweet, sauce-led pudding, with a moist, dark sponge beneath a generous covering of buttery toffee sauce. The sponge is described as light yet rich, so its appeal is not simply a heavy texture. Deep, caramelised flavour comes from the sauce, which gives the dessert its distinctive toffee character and makes sweetness central to each mouthful.

Warm serving brings out the comforting character of this traditional British dessert. Vanilla ice cream is described as melting against the pudding, while thick, hot custard offers an alternative warm accompaniment. Check which option your pub offers before ordering. It suits an end to a hearty meal when you still want something rich and sweet.
value:

Check the local menu for those prices and the pudding's accompaniment before choosing. A confirmed serving option is more useful than assuming extras are included.

The pudding is tagged vegetarian in our data, and cereals containing gluten are the listed allergen. That makes the gluten information important for diners with coeliac disease or a gluten allergy. A vegetarian tag does not establish suitability for a vegan diet.

The allergen list here should not replace the pub's current information. Ask staff to check the pudding, sauce and chosen accompaniment together. Swapping ice cream for custard, or making another change, can alter the allergens in your order.

bestFor.title: Traditional pudding fans
bestFor.text: This suits diners looking for a familiar British dessert built around moist sponge and sweet toffee sauce, rather than choosing a chocolate or fruit-based option.

bestFor.title: A chilly evening
bestFor.text: A warm pudding suits the end of a meal on a chilly evening. Ask which accompaniment is offered if you particularly want hot custard.

bestFor.title: A sweet finish
bestFor.text: The rich, buttery sauce makes this a good fit for diners who actively want a sweet finish. Choose it for the toffee flavour, not a restrained dessert.
